This '''space station''' was located in the outlying [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]] during the early part of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The young [[Tarrin Datch/Legends|Tarrin Datch]], whose family owned nearby [[Pellezara station]], often used this outlying [[Space station/Legends|station]] as a stunt range for his daredevil [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] fancies. This station featured a well-equipped medicenter.

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Datch helped a [[Unidentified Alliance freighter|fugitive freighter]] affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which was undergoing maintenance at Pellezara, escape Imperial pursuit by jumping into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and taking temporary refuge at this outlying station.
